notes.title: Major Update: "The Hero's Return, Princess Rescue Operation"
notes.notes:
🏆 Restoring the Balance of Gold: The New Era of Diamond-Gold Exchange
The kingdom's economists have readjusted the exchange rate between diamonds and gold for our heroes! Now you can exchange treasures according to their true value. Prepare more efficiently for the powerful weapons and armor needed to rescue the princess!

🛡️ Dark Bugs Retreat Before the Hero's Sword
The evil bugs that hindered the hero's journey have retreated. No more getting lost in the labyrinthine forest or being suddenly ejected from the dragon's fortress. The journey to the princess is now smoother than ever!

✨ The Kingdom's Map Shines Brighter
The interface for our heroes has been reborn by the royal wizards' touch. From quest lists to item management, everything has been reorganized more intuitively so you can focus all your energy on rescuing the princess!
Brave hero, set forth to rescue the princess with more balanced rewards, a stable journey, and a more beautiful kingdom map! The future of the kingdom rests in your hands!
